استهلكن (form X)
# اِسْتَهْلَكْنَ (istahlakna) /is.tah.lak.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اُسْتُهْلِكْنَ (ustuhlikna) /us.tuh.lik.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# اِسْتَهْلِكْنَ (istahlikna) /is.tah.lik.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
